name: Vaccine Waning Models
title: Vaccine Waning Models
answer: Vaccine waning models estimate how protection from vaccination declines over time for specific pathogens and populations. They are used to compare durability across vaccine platforms, age groups, and prior infection histories, and to inform booster timing and outbreak response. The models typically output waning curves for infection, symptomatic disease, severe disease, or antibody titres. They sit within epidemiological surveillance and vaccine effectiveness research rather than individual clinical prediction.

crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

sections.body: Vaccine waning models estimate how protection from vaccination declines over time for specific pathogens and populations. They are used to compare durability across vaccine platforms, age groups, and prior infection histories, and to inform booster timing and outbreak response. The models typically output waning curves for infection, symptomatic disease, severe disease, or antibody titres. They sit within epidemiological surveillance and vaccine effectiveness research rather than individual clinical prediction.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: These models run on longitudinal cohort data, test-negative case-control studies, serological surveys, and linked immunization and health records. Computation ranges from standard statistical packages on a single workstation to larger Bayesian fitting jobs on institutional clusters or cloud instances. The main constraint is usually data linkage and assay standardization, not raw compute. Some groups use electronic health record cohorts with repeated antibody measurements or infection outcomes.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: Common approaches include survival models with time-varying vaccine exposure, Bayesian hierarchical models that pool evidence across studies, and mechanistic models that track immune memory compartments. Waning is often represented as a decay function, such as exponential or Weibull, applied to vaccine effectiveness or neutralizing titre. Model fitting may use Markov chain Monte Carlo or maximum likelihood, with identifiability checks for time since vaccination versus calendar time and variant circulation.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: The main risks are biased estimates from confounding by infection history, testing behavior, and selective boosting, and the misuse of waning curves to justify policy without accounting for severity. Data provenance matters because linked health records may carry re-identification risk and require data sharing agreements. Model outputs used in public health decisions should be validated against independent data and reported with uncertainty intervals, not as single point estimates. No model here gives individual medical advice.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: The field is moving toward models that jointly estimate waning, variant escape, and immune imprinting from routine surveillance and genomic data. There is growing interest in predicting durability from early immune markers and in generating age-specific and product-specific waning schedules. Real-time updating during outbreaks and integration with transmission models are likely to become standard. Causal inference methods may help separate true biological waning from apparent waning caused by shifting exposure risk.
